title: Baby Sleep: Safe Sleep and Calmer Nights (Up to One Year)
description: Ten lessons for parents from birth until the baby completes their first year: prepare a safe space for every sleep, understand night waking, read tired and sleepy cues, keep a short, calm bedtime routine, keep night feeds calm and safe, move gradually from your arms to the cot, soothe crying safely, use dhikr and du'a in a soft voice before sleep, look after the parents' own rest and ask for help, and know when to get medical help for the baby; throughout, tell normal variation apart from danger signs needing urgent help.

primary_reference.info: American Academy of Pediatrics: Safe sleep and feeding. NHS: Sleep, feeding and emergencies. US CDC: development and hunger cues. World Health Organization: breastfeeding.
